featuredProject.name: FaceGate — Face Recognition Attendance System
featuredProject.summary: Face recognition attendance system using CCTV with deep-learning face embeddings (512-dimension). Features anti-spoofing, auto-reconnect RTSP, dual camera support, face tracking, attendance logging, and a web interface for realtime camera control.

repositories.name: FaceGate — Attendance System
repositories.summary: Otomasi absensi dengan face recognition, anti-spoofing, dual CCTV RTSP, face tracking, dan web interface realtime.

repositories.name: MyWajah — Face Attendance & HR Dashboard
repositories.summary: Aplikasi mobile absensi karyawan berbasis face recognition (React Native + Expo): scan wajah on-device dengan liveness check, verifikasi lokasi GPS, dan admin dashboard realtime.
highlights: Face embedding on-device (InspireFace SDK) + liveness detection — cegah absensi pakai foto/video
Verifikasi kecocokan wajah dilakukan server-side (cosine similarity), client tidak bisa memalsukan status
Verifikasi lokasi GPS saat check-in/check-out
Admin dashboard realtime: kelola karyawan, departemen, jam kerja, laporan keterlambatan
Source code privat, tapi APK publik bisa didownload di github.com/AdrianTriSetiawan/MyWajah-releases
Admin dashboard live di mywajah-admin.adriandev.online

repositories.name: EProcMon — BUMN Tender Intelligence
repositories.summary: Sistem monitoring tender pengadaan BUMN Indonesia 24/7. Scrapes portal LPSE/SPSE, klasifikasi tender IT via keyword matching, notifikasi real-time via Discord. Monorepo: Elysia.js API + SvelteKit dashboard + scraper worker.
highlights: Scraping otomatis ratusan portal LPSE/SPSE BUMN Indonesia
Klasifikasi tender IT menggunakan 50+ keyword bahasa Indonesia dan Inggris
Notifikasi Discord real-time saat tender IT baru ditemukan
Dashboard SvelteKit dengan Supabase Realtime WebSocket
Live di ai.adriandev.online/tender-ai

repositories.name: NotifGate — WhatsApp Notification & CS SaaS
repositories.summary: Platform WhatsApp notification self-hosted. Kirim notifikasi via REST API dengan queue, retry, dan idempotency key. Kelola customer service inbox multi-agent dan pair banyak nomor WhatsApp lewat QR dari satu dashboard. Live di notif.adriandev.online.
highlights: REST API: POST /api/notifications, NotifGate handle queue, retry exponential, dan logging
Customer service inbox multi-agent dengan role owner/admin/agent dan riwayat lengkap
Multi device: pair beberapa nomor WhatsApp via QR, session aman dan bisa di-revoke
Outbox dengan idempotency key, webhook delivery status, rate limit per device, audit trail
AI reply assist dan multi-tenant, self-hosted (data milik sendiri)
Live di notif.adriandev.online
